---
title: "Water infrastructure · IVI"
format: dashboard
---

```{ojs}
//| output: false
csdRaw = FileAttachment("data/ivi_csd_year.csv").csv({typed: true})
provinceRaw = FileAttachment("data/ivi_province_year.csv").csv({typed: true})
csdData = csdRaw.filter(d => d.province && d.CSDNAME)
provinceData = provinceRaw.filter(d => d.province)
provinces = [...new Set(provinceData.map(d => d.province))].sort()
```

# Overview

## {.sidebar}

```{ojs}
viewof province = Inputs.select(provinces, {label: "Province", value: "British Columbia"})
viewof csd = Inputs.select(["Entire assessed province", ...new Set(csdData.filter(d => d.province === province).map(d => d.CSDNAME + " · " + d.CSDUID))].sort(), {label: "CSD", value: "Entire assessed province"})
viewof year = Inputs.select([2025, 2030, 2040, 2050, 2060, 2070, 2080, 2090, 2100], {label: "Evaluation year", value: 2025, format: value => String(value)})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
trajectory = csd === "Entire assessed province" ? provinceData.filter(d => d.province === province) : csdData.filter(d => d.province === province && d.CSDNAME + " · " + d.CSDUID === csd)
selected = trajectory.find(d => d.year === year)
number = (x, digits = 1) => x == null || !Number.isFinite(x) ? "No estimate" : x.toLocaleString("en-CA", {maximumFractionDigits: digits})
```

## Row {height=180}

### Infrastructure value index

```{ojs}
html`<div class="metric">${number(selected?.IVI, 3)}</div><div class="metric-label">Remaining benchmark service-life fraction</div>`
```

### Service life consumed

```{ojs}
html`<div class="metric">${number(selected?.service_life_consumed_score)}${selected?.service_life_consumed_score == null ? "" : "%"}</div><div class="metric-label">100 × (1 − IVI)</div>`
```

### Assessed replacement value

```{ojs}
html`<div class="metric">${selected?.assessed_replacement_value == null ? "No estimate" : "$" + number(selected.assessed_replacement_value / 1e6) + "M"}</div><div class="metric-label">2020 dollars</div>`
```

## Row

### IVI trajectory

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({height: 300, marginLeft: 55, x: {label: "Evaluation year", tickFormat: "d"}, y: {domain: [0, 1], label: "IVI"}, marks: [Plot.ruleY([0]), Plot.lineY(trajectory.filter(d => d.IVI != null), {x: "year", y: "IVI", stroke: "#000000", strokeWidth: 3}), Plot.dot(trajectory.filter(d => d.year === year && d.IVI != null), {x: "year", y: "IVI", fill: "#000000", r: 6})]})
```

### Provincial coverage and benchmark-life exposure

```{ojs}
//| output: false
statsSelected = provinceData.find(d => d.province === statsProvince && d.year === statsYear)
```

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(statsSelected ? [
  {Metric: "Mapped pipe length (km)", Value: number(statsSelected.mapped_length_m / 1000)},
  {Metric: "Assessed pipe length (km)", Value: number(statsSelected.assessed_length_m / 1000)},
  {Metric: "Age/lifespan coverage (%)", Value: number(statsSelected.age_lifespan_length_coverage == null ? null : statsSelected.age_lifespan_length_coverage * 100)},
  {Metric: "Replacement value reaching benchmark life ($M)", Value: number(statsSelected.benchmark_replacement_value == null ? null : statsSelected.benchmark_replacement_value / 1e6)},
  {Metric: "Benchmark cost share (%)", Value: number(statsSelected.benchmark_cost_share == null ? null : statsSelected.benchmark_cost_share * 100)},
  {Metric: "Excluded records", Value: number(statsSelected.excluded_records, 0)}
] : [], {rows: 6})
```

## Row {height=560}

### CSD comparison · selected province and year

```{ojs}
html`<div class="summary-table">${Inputs.table(csdData.filter(d => d.province === statsProvince && d.year === statsYear).map(d => ({CSD: d.CSDNAME, CSDUID: String(d.CSDUID), IVI: d.IVI, "Consumed (%)": d.service_life_consumed_score, "Replacement value ($M)": d.assessed_replacement_value == null ? null : d.assessed_replacement_value / 1e6, "Age/lifespan coverage (%)": d.age_lifespan_length_coverage == null ? null : d.age_lifespan_length_coverage * 100})), {sort: "IVI", rows: 15, width: 1100})}</div>`
```

# Canada map

## Row {height=140}

### Map controls

```{ojs}
viewof mapRegion = Inputs.select(["Canada", ...provinces], {label: "Map extent", value: "Canada"})
viewof mapYear = Inputs.select([2025, 2030, 2040, 2050, 2060, 2070, 2080, 2090, 2100], {label: "Evaluation year", value: 2025, format: value => String(value)})
viewof mapMetric = Inputs.select(new Map([["Service life consumed (%) · higher means lower IVI", "service_life_consumed_score"], ["Assessed replacement value ($M, 2020 dollars)", "assessed_replacement_value"]]), {label: "Shade by", value: "service_life_consumed_score"})
```

## Row {height=600}

### Assessed CSDs across Canada

```{ojs}
//| output: false
d3 = require("d3@7")
canada = FileAttachment("data/canada_provinces.geojson").json()
csdGeometry = FileAttachment("data/assessed_csds.geojson").json()
mapLookup = new Map(csdData.filter(d => d.year === mapYear).map(d => [String(d.CSDUID), d]))
mapFeatures = csdGeometry.features.map(feature => {
  const row = mapLookup.get(String(feature.properties.CSDUID));
  const raw = row?.[mapMetric];
  return {...feature, row, value: raw == null || !Number.isFinite(raw) ? null : mapMetric === "assessed_replacement_value" ? raw / 1e6 : raw};
})
mapDomain = mapRegion === "Canada" ? canada : {...canada, features: canada.features.filter(d => d.properties.province === mapRegion)}
visibleFeatures = mapFeatures.filter(d => mapRegion === "Canada" || d.row?.province === mapRegion)
mapLabel = mapMetric === "assessed_replacement_value" ? "Assessed replacement value ($M, 2020 dollars)" : "Service life consumed (%)"
```

```{ojs}
{
const chart = Plot.plot({
  height: 540,
  projection: {type: "conic-conformal", rotate: [96, 0], parallels: [49, 77], domain: mapDomain},
  color: {type: "linear", scheme: "Greys", domain: mapMetric === "service_life_consumed_score" ? [0, 100] : [0, Math.max(1, ...visibleFeatures.map(d => d.value ?? 0))], legend: true, label: mapLabel},
  marks: [
    Plot.geo(canada, {fill: "#fff", stroke: "#bbb", strokeWidth: 0.6}),
    Plot.geo(visibleFeatures.filter(d => d.value != null), {
      fill: d => d.value, stroke: "#555", strokeWidth: 0.5,
      title: d => `${d.properties.CSDNAME} (${d.properties.CSDUID})\n${mapLabel}: ${number(d.value)}\nIVI: ${number(d.row?.IVI, 3)}\nAge/lifespan coverage: ${number(d.row?.age_lifespan_length_coverage * 100)}%`
    })
  ]
});
  const geoLayer = chart.querySelector('g[aria-label="geo"]');
  const svg = geoLayer.ownerSVGElement;
  const layer = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "g");
  for (const child of [...svg.children]) {
    if (!["style", "defs"].includes(child.tagName.toLowerCase())) layer.append(child);
  }
  svg.append(layer);
  svg.style.touchAction = "none";
  svg.style.cursor = "grab";
  svg.style.overflow = "hidden";
  svg.querySelectorAll("path").forEach(path => path.setAttribute("vector-effect", "non-scaling-stroke"));
  const zoom = d3.zoom().scaleExtent([1, 128]).on("zoom", event => layer.setAttribute("transform", event.transform));
  const selection = d3.select(svg).call(zoom);
  const controls = html`<div class="map-zoom"><button type="button" aria-label="Zoom in">+</button><button type="button" aria-label="Zoom out">−</button><button type="button">Reset view</button></div>`;
  controls.children[0].onclick = () => selection.call(zoom.scaleBy, 2);
  controls.children[1].onclick = () => selection.call(zoom.scaleBy, 0.5);
  controls.children[2].onclick = () => selection.call(zoom.transform, d3.zoomIdentity);
  return html`<div class="interactive-map">${controls}${chart}</div>`;
}

```
